notes: TopoI depletion via mf-lon degron (topA-PDT3A) = knockdown. CRISPRi + plasmid TopoI (WT or Gly5/G703P/Y704A) set labelled genotype multiple (degron + CRISPRi knockdown of chromosomal topA plus plasmid expression of WT or mutant TopoI). AtC and arabinose are inducers, not treatments. Control = mf-lon WT with AtC (reference genotype carrying the protease, induced like the test strain). Phase only for the CRISPRi set (final OD 0.5 in LB); first set (4 h post induction after dilution, no OD) left without phase.
